answer: Persistent work credit: each agent identity accrues credit only through verified completed tasks, and new identities start at zero. A dune of unrewarded effort awaits any clone, since splitting work across fresh IDs forfeits accumulated priority. Every raven claiming a high-value task must post a refundable deposit sized to its credit score, so cloning multiplies locked capital. An attacker pays the timber of full deposit per identity plus lost task history, making one honest record cheaper than many empty clones.
